uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7841.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

710-5147-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-5147-8207.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

225-2557-4365-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2557-4826-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature that has power 2 or greater

1987-7487-7907.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-7487-7907.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-7487-7907.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1563-2457-7296-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2946-4871-6026-6797.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-6026-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5147-5542-6136.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6136.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Avenging Hunter from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Avenging Hunter.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Avenging Hunter token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6136.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3532-5078-5705-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5705-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa and Glaring Fleshraker's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Medusa trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

413-4681-6542-7747.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Giant-Sized Flying Ant trigger, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

647-1368-1563-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
647-1368-1563-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3918-4131-6893.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn has twenty or more charge counters on it.
3918-4131-6893.description:
Activate Trazyn using The Eternity Elevator's ability by tapping it, adding at least twenty mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's ability by paying {3}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
3918-4131-6893.notes: Once you have extra mana, Basalt Monolith's ability can be used instead to add mana.

6797-6972-7509.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
6797-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2034-3693-4668-5224.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
2034-3693-4668-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4211-5660-6701.description:
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tormod's Crypt ability.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Repeat.

725-1329-1778-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Memnite, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Memnite, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

2440-4050-5147-6970.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for Abby's commander tax
2440-4050-5147-6970.notablePrerequisites: Abby's commander tax is at least {4}.
2440-4050-5147-6970.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Cordyceps Infected creature tokens.
When the Cordyceps Infected tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers that many times, adding {C} for each Fungus and/or Zombie you control for each trigger.
Resolve Abby, giving control of it to an opponent.
Activate Goblin Bombardment four times by sacrificing four Cordyceps Infected tokens, dealing 4 damage to Abby.
Abby dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Choose to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Cordyceps Infected tokens, adding {R}{G}.
Repeat.

1978-3263-5711.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
1978-3263-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Fanatic of Rhonas.
Repeat

1251-6188-6911.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent. There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-6188-6911.description:
Declare Fear of Missing Out as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Fear of Missing Out, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that isn't legendary.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters, it triggers, causing you to rummage
During your next combat phase, declare Fear of Missing Out and the Fear of Missing Out token as attackers.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, causing you to untap the nontoken Fear of Missing Out and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1497-2173-4063-5220.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-3562-4679-6821.description:
Cast Jump Scare by paying {W}, targeting Sky Hussar.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sky Hussar.
When the Sky Hussar token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Sky Hussar token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

5078-6709-6766.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
5078-6709-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

800-3043-4116.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
800-3043-4116.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Axebane Guardian.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least {3}{U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

2850-5256--71.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the ability from step 1, milling target player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

575-2981-4319-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-2981-4319-5441.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Granite Witness.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

856-1575-5256-5903.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other artifact.
856-1575-5256-5903.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, causing target player to mill cards equal to Cauldron Familiar's power.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-5361-5521.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Auton Soldier does not have summoning sickness.
Captain's Claws attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
1270-5361-5521.description:
Declare Auton Soldier and the creature with Captain's Claws as attackers.
Auton Soldier's myriad ability and Captain's Claws trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, creating nine token copies of itself as a nonlegendary copy of Ojer Taq attacking each other opponent.
Resolve the Captain's Claws trigger, creating 3^(the number of Ojer Taqs you control) 1/1 Kor Ally creature tokens tapped and attacking an opponent.

2178-4702.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff and Splinter Twin attached to the same legendary creature that does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4702.description:
Activate the legendary creature with Splinter Twin and Thornbite Staff attached by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Put the token legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the creature token dies, the legendary creature triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

215-2092-4617-5115.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
215-2092-4617-5115.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin three times by paying {3}, adding eight {R}.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {G}, returning Soulbright Flamekin to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

527-3138-4124.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power six or greater.
527-3138-4124.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, targeting Selvala.
Malachite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Selvala.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power seven or greater, this combo nets infinite colored mana, and you may then target any other permanent using Malachite Talisman's ability.

169-413-2825-3152.notablePrerequisites:
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
169-413-2825-3152.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {0} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pact of the Titan without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Resolve Pact of the Titan, creating a 4/4 Giant creature token.When the Giant enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Giant, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

222-3719-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with base power eight or greater.
You control at least one Saproling.
222-3719-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Ruthless Technomancer, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and Ruthless Technomancer to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Ruthless Technomancer enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Ruthless Technomancer trigger, causing you to sacrifice the nontoken creature with base power eight or greater and create at least eight Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and the nontoken creature with base power eight or greater to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
If the nontoken creature has base power nine or greater, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

2498-3260-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 5.
2498-3260-4691.description:
Activate Vilis by paying 4 life, targeting any creature.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw four cards.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers four times, causing you to gain eight life.
Repeat as many times as desired.
Resolve all Vilis abilities, giving the targeted creature(s) -1/-1 until end of turn for each ability.

1217-2232-2757-3474.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Forest and a basic Plains.
1217-2232-2757-3474.description:
Activate a basic Plains and a basic Forest you control by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Cast Yoshimaru by paying {W}.
Yoshimaru enters the battlefield, triggering Jedit Ojanen and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Jedit Ojanen trigger, causing you to pay {G} to create a 2/2 Cat Warrior creature token.
The Cat Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft twice by tapping the Cat Warrior token and Yoshimaru, untapping a basic Forest and a basic Plains.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Yoshimaru from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2835-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2835-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

893-1651-3129.description:
Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Myr tokens, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.
